Get started as a logistics employee and get hourly guarantee of 40 hours a week! You can also count on a job for longer period of time. To top it all off, you work in a very pleasant team with a good team leader who helps you get the best out of yourself. Apply as a warehouse worker at GXO Schiphol!

This job does not provide accommodation. If you need a job with accommodation, you can best contact our department eu-flex via lookingforajob@tempo-team.nl

Apply now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions, so that we can help you quickly. Don't have WhatsApp? Then we will contact you by phone or e-mail!

What we offer
- A full-time job and weekends off!
- Earn € 2600 per month including allowances
- A job for a longer period of time
- A job where your development is important
- Travel allowance of €7.30 max per day
- Allowances in the evening up to 25%

Who you are
As a logistics employee at GXO it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You are full-time available from Monday to Friday
- You are available in rotating shifts from 6:00 AM to 15:00 PM and 15:00 PM to 22:00 PM
- You live within 30 kilometers of Schiphol so you can get here easily and quickly
- You are physically fit to lift boxes up until 20 kilograms
- You speak English

What will you do
You will work full-time as a logistics employee, 40 hours a week. Monday to Friday is your standard working week in a fixed schedule! This will be in 2 shifts (6:00 AM - 15:00 PM and 13:00 PM - 22:00 PM). As a logistics employee you will work in the inbound or outbound department. Together with your team you are responsible for all orders. These must be placed in the right place or collected for shipment. You can also learn to drive a reach truck and collect orders with it. With your order list you drive through the warehouse to collect all orders together. It is important that you do this safely and accurately. You will pack and seal the orders. Sometimes you have

Are you a motivated team player with a passion for logistics? Are you looking for a challenging position in which you can use your organizational skills and would you like to work with car parts from top brands such as Audi, BMW and Volkswagen? Then this is your chance! Become an order picker at our client! In addition to the satisfaction of productive work, you will receive a salary of up to €2,582.- gross per month. You will also receive travel allowance, a good pension and much more! Are you ready for this challenge? Then apply quickly!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for an order picker for Global Parts Europe B.V. in Nunspeet.

As an order picker you will work with a wide range of car parts from top brands such as Audi, BMW and Volkswagen. Think of bumpers, roofs, trunk lids, windshields and mirrors. How cool is it to be surrounded by high-quality parts from the automotive world every day? Many of these parts are surprisingly light, and handy tools are available for the heavier items. This allows you to work efficiently and without heavy loads! Some of your tasks are:

    - Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
    
- Order picking, packaging and shipping of products
    
- Ensuring an organized and efficient warehouse

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary from €2,582.- per month
    
- Travel expense reimbursement according to the client's policy
    
- Part-time or full-time job of 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Temporary contract through Manpower
    
- Free development opportunities via Manpower Academy (more than 200 online training courses)
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Growth opportunities

 

    - Experience in a similar role is an advantage, but not required
    
- Willingness to perform physical work
    
- Accuracy and attention to detail
    
- Good command of the English language due to the nature of the work

Preferably you live in Nunspeet, Harderwijk, Vaassen, Epe, Zwolle, Wezep, Hattem, Apeldoorn, Zeewolde, Elburg, Kampen or Dron

Love driving and looking for a great job? Jump into the cabin of a modern truck! As a C/CE Driver at Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, you are the face of a family business. You will drive routes to deliver fresh bread to supermarkets every day. And the rewards? Very good! You get a great salary (Bakery CAO) plus extra money for working night hours. Enjoy a flexible job with a good work-life balance, and we will take care of your yearly Code 95 training. Ready to hit the road? 🌍

What we offer
- €18.21 to €22.12 per hour (excluding allowances)!
- Lots of freedom and independence behind the wheel!
- Peace and quiet on the road
- Build your pension from day one!
- Get your Code 95 and other training via Tempo-Team
- Grab those extra's for working nights & weekends!

Who you are
Would you love to work as a driver in a family business? As our driver, you make sure the fresh bread gets to the customers right on time. You are exactly the person we are looking for if you:

- Have a valid C or CE driving license.
- Have your Code 95 up to date.
- Speak and write good Dutch or English.

What will you do
What does your workday look like?

- Early start & coffee: Start your day between 01:30 and 04:00 AM at the bakery in Alphen aan den Rijn with a hot cup of coffee.
- Load up: Load your truck independently with carts of delicious, fresh-smelling bread.
- Hit the road: Drive a fixed route to about 5 or 6 supermarkets (like Jumbo).
- Deliver & handle admin: Unload neatly at the dock, check the delivery notes, take back empty returns, and fill in your trip reports.
- Done by 10:00 AM! Park the truck back at the bakery and enjoy having the rest of the day completely free! 🥖

Where will you work
About your new employer:

- A proud history: You will join Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, a modern industrial family business that has been around for over 100 years! As part of the Bake Five group, they bake fresh bread for major supermarkets every day.

For the Sealing & Polymer department, we are looking for an enthusiastic Prep & Finish Operator. You will join a dynamic team where quality, precision, and collaboration are key. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that products are carefully prepared and finished, meeting the highest quality standards.

As a Prep & Finish Operator, you are responsible for various activities within the production process. During the prep phase, you clean metal parts using special fluids, sandblast components to optimally prepare the surface, clean them again, and apply a primer. During the finish phase, you use ice blasting to complete the final treatment of the products before they move on to the next stage of the process. You work accurately according to established quality guidelines and, together with your colleagues, ensure that every product is delivered in perfect condition.

You will work a fixed schedule from Monday to Friday during day shifts, from 07:30 to 16:00 or from 08:00 to 16:30. For this position, it is important that you are physically fit and comfortable handling products weighing up to approximately 30 kilograms. In addition, you work carefully, have technical insight, and have a good command of the Dutch and/or English language.

Are you looking for a varied position within an international and innovative company where craftsmanship and quality are highly valued? Apply now and become part of the ERIKS team in Alkmaar!

- You have a calm and focused personality and work accurately and precisely
- You are physically fit and comfortable working with products weighing up to approximately 30 kg
- You communicate clearly when you encounter any issues or challenges
- You have a technical affinity; experience in areas such as ICT, jewelry making, metalworking, or surface treatment is a plus
- You have a good command of the Dutch and/or English language

Are you looking for a job within metal technology? Do you enjoy working in day or 2-shift operation and are you team-oriented? Then read on!

Are you interested?
You can apply directly via the website using the button! Questions? Call 077-3828946 and ask for Mette or July

What will you do
As a Warehouse Employee, you are the heart of our logistics process. You start by unloading trucks full of packages. You make sure everything is moved onto the sorting belts smoothly. 📦 You scan the parcels so they head to the right destination. Lifting packages up to 23 kg keeps you fit while you earn money! It's productive work that gives you a real sense of achievement at the end of the day!

- Workdays between Monday to Saturday
- Morning shift: 03:00 to 07:30
- Afternoon shift: 16:00 to 19:30
